result.title: TableRouter: Query-Aware Evidence Construction for Long-Table Question Answering
result.comment: Submitted to ACL Rolling Review, October 2026
result.summary: LLMs can reason over tables, but when tables outgrow the context budget, retrieving relevant rows is only part of the solution. A retrieved subset may omit information required for an exact aggregate; even complete evidence may remain difficult for an LLM to use. We introduce TableRouter, a training-free framework that analyzes each query, then chooses between two routes: a computation route, which derives question-conditioned statistics from the full table, and a coverage route, which retrieves relevant rows and column summaries. The chosen context is passed to a frozen LLM in one call. Across three LLMs and three large-table benchmarks, TableRouter outperforms the strongest of six single-call baselines in all nine settings by 1.2-18.3 accuracy points, using 77-95% fewer estimated FLOPs than truncated-table prompting, with indexing amortized across questions. The gains extend to long tables from databases not used in earlier experiments, where TableRouter achieves 35.8% with Qwen2.5-7B, versus 16.4% for the strongest external baseline. A controlled experiment shows that explicitly providing computed statistics improves accuracy by up to 40.0 points, even when all answer-determining rows are available. These results distinguish evidence access from evidence use: long-table reasoning depends on how information is represented, not only on which rows are retrieved.

AI.brief_summary: 提出免训练的 TableRouter：先分析查询，再在「计算路线」（从全表导出问题条件统计量）与「覆盖路线」（检索相关行与列摘要）之间选择，将所选上下文单次送入冻结 LLM；在三个大表基准上优于六种单次调用基线，并用对照实验区分「取得证据」与「使用证据」。
AI.relevance_reason: 其按查询决定检索还是压缩为统计表示的路由机制，以及「证据可获得不等于被使用」的发现，可能为 LVR 的视觉证据筛选与表示形式是否被答案真正使用提供可核查线索；但对象为表格文本、无 latent 推理状态，迁移需自行判断。
